description: Delta-wing fighter on a kerbed and landscaped display bed at the entrance area of the Malian Air Force base at Bamako-Senou, beside the Foyer de l'Aviateur and about 40 m from a second displayed MiG. Present and clearly plinthed in Esri World Imagery dated 12 January 2024 and in current Google imagery. Surveyed and tagged on OpenStreetMap as a Mali Air Force MiG-21. aviationmuseum.eu reports a Bamako MiG-21bis wearing the false serial TZ-BA-100 with a true identity of TZ-372; that identification is single-sourced, from 2016, and given for a different coordinate in the city centre, so no serial is recorded here and the variant is left blank.

Swept-wing fighter on a second kerbed display bed about 40 m south of the MiG-21 at the same Bamako-Senou site, likewise present in Esri imagery dated 12 January 2024. Type identification is contested: the OpenStreetMap surveyor recorded it as a MiG-15 while aviationmuseum.eu lists a MiG-17F at a Bamako army museum. MiG-17 is used here because Mali is documented as a MiG-17F operator and the aviation-specialist source is the more reliable of the two, but satellite resolution cannot separate the two types and this should be treated as unsettled.
